pages.text: Welcome, engineer! $(l)CyberFarm$() lets you build modular drones that run your farms for you, and the machines and power plants that keep them going. This page is a map of the handbook.

$(li)You build a drone from a $(l)frame$(), one or more $(l)function modules$() and optional $(l)addons$(). It lives on a $(l)Drone Dock$() and does the work while you do something more fun.$(br)$(li)Drones and machines run on $(l)FE$() (Forge Energy). Power from any other tech mod works too.
pages.title: Good to know

pages.text: $(li)Hold $(l)G$() over a CyberFarm item, in your inventory or in JEI, to open its page here.$(br)$(li)The info page (the $(l)"i"$() tab) of any CyberFarm machine gives a quick explanation.
$(li)Using $(l)JEI$() or $(l)REI$()? Look up the uses of a machine to see what it takes, what it makes and its numbers. Look up the Drone Assembler to see what each frame tier can hold.

$(li)$(l:basics/getting_started)Getting Started$(/l): your first drone, step by step.$(br)$(li)$(l:basics/cyber_frame)Cyber Frame$(/l): the block most machines need beside them.$(br)$(li)$(l:basics/muffler)Muffler$(/l): silences machines, drones and mobs around it.$(br)$(li)$(l:basics/water_pump)Water Pump$(/l): an endless supply of water for your machines.
pages.title: Start here

pages.text: $(li)$(l:basics/laser_turret)Laser Turret$(/l): keeps monsters away at night. A drone with a $(l:drone_systems/modules)Guard Module$(/l) does too.$(br)$(li)$(l:basics/multiblock_projector)Multiblock Projector$(/l): shows a big structure in the world before you build it.

$(l:materials/materials)Materials and Progression$(/l)$(br2)The three tiers and their materials: $(l:materials/aluminum)Aluminum$(/l) from the $(l:materials/electrolyzer)Electrolyzer$(/l), $(l:materials/circuits)Circuits$(/l) from the $(l:materials/fabricator)Fabricator$(/l), and $(l:materials/carbon_fiber)Carbon Fiber$(/l) from the $(l:materials/pyrolysis_oven)Pyrolysis Oven$(/l).$(br2)$(l:generators/generators)Generators$(/l)
pages.title: Sections

pages.text: Making FE: the $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generator$(/l), then $(l:generators/gas_power)Gas Power$(/l) with the $(l:generators/biomass_press)Biomass Press$(/l), $(l:generators/bio_digester)Bio-Digester$(/l), $(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l) and $(l:generators/gas_turbine)Gas Turbine$(/l), the $(l:generators/acid_synthesizer)Acid Synthesizer$(/l) and the $(l:generators/steam_engine)Steam Engine$(/l).$(br2)$(l:nuclear/nuclear)Nuclear$(/l)

The endgame power plant: $(l:nuclear/uranium)uranium$(/l) and $(l:nuclear/fuel_rod)Fuel Rods$(/l), the $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l), the $(l:nuclear/coolant_mixer)Coolant Mixer$(/l), the $(l:nuclear/steam_turbine)Steam Turbine$(/l), $(l:nuclear/radiation)waste and radiation$(/l), the $(l:nuclear/waste_reprocessor)Waste Reprocessor$(/l) and the $(l:nuclear/hazmat_suit)Hazmat Suit$(/l) and $(l:nuclear/geiger_counter)Geiger Counter$(/l).$(br2)$(l:energy_storage/energy_storage)Energy Storage$(/l)

Keeping power for later: the small $(l:energy_storage/battery_bank)Battery Bank$(/l), and the big $(l:energy_storage/resonance_core)Resonance Core$(/l) with its Resonance Cells and Stabilizer Pylons.$(br2)$(l:cables/cables)Cables$(/l)

Moving power and fluids: the $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduit$(/l), $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipe$(/l), $(l:cables/liquid_pipe)Liquid Pipe$(/l), $(l:cables/fluid_tanks)Liquid and Gas Tanks$(/l) and $(l:cables/dish_transmission)Dish Transmission$(/l) to send power through the air.$(br2)$(l:drone_systems/drone_systems)Drones$(/l)

Building and running drones: the $(l:drone_systems/drone_assembler)Drone Assembler$(/l), $(l:drone_systems/drone_frames)Drone Frames$(/l), $(l:drone_systems/modules)Function Modules$(/l), $(l:drone_systems/addons)Addons$(/l), the $(l:drone_systems/drone_dock)Drone Dock$(/l) and $(l:drone_systems/drones)Using Drones$(/l); then the $(l:drone_systems/hologram_table)Hologram Table$(/l), $(l:drone_systems/supply_terminal)Supply Terminal$(/l) and the $(l:drone_systems/tech_village)Tech Village$(/l).$(br2)$(l:mech/mech)Mech$(/l)

A pilotable mech, three and a half blocks tall, built around a $(l:mech/mech_core)Mech Core$(/l) grown in the $(l:mech/crystallizer)Crystallizer$(/l). The $(l:mech/mech_hangar)Mech Hangar$(/l) charges and repairs it and fits its $(l:mech/mech_modules)modules$(/l).$(br2)$(l:trinkets/trinkets)Trinkets$(/l)
Wearable tech in a Trinkets tab of its own: Gravity Boots, a Neural Chip with programs and a Utility Belt, charged on the Human Dock and made at the Trinket Table.
